ForPropertyManagers.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions for property management firms

faq.question: Do you invoice per building, or one single invoice for my whole portfolio?
faq.answer: Each community gets its own invoice, itemising the services it has contracted, even though you manage several buildings with us. That way every residents' association sees exactly what its own community pays, without it being mixed with the rest of your portfolio.

faq.question: Do I need a separate contract for each community?
faq.answer: Yes, each community signs its own service contract (they're separate legal entities), but you keep the same point of contact and the same service standard across every building you manage with us, so adding a new one doesn't mean renegotiating from scratch.

faq.question: If an issue affects several communities in my portfolio, who do I contact?
faq.answer: Your usual contact at Imora: there's no need to report separately to a different concierge, cleaning company and technician at each building. A single team coordinates the response even though the communities are legally independent.

faq.question: Can I add a new building without renegotiating the terms of the others?
faq.answer: Yes, each new building is quoted based on the services that specific community needs, but we apply the same reporting process and the same service standard you already know from the rest of your portfolio, without having to re-explain how you work.

faq.question: What if a community in my portfolio already has a service contracted with another provider?
faq.answer: We can step in only for the services the community decides to outsource to us, and coordinate the handover with the outgoing provider so there's no coverage gap during the switch.

faq.question: Do I get a single report covering all my communities, or do I need to check building by building?
faq.answer: Your contact at Imora knows the status of every community in your portfolio, so you can ask for a combined view instead of having to ask service by service and building by building.

faq.question: Does the inspection team visit all my buildings, or only the ones with problems?
faq.answer: We visit every community with contracted services, not only the ones that have had an incident, precisely to catch a problem before it reaches the residents' meeting.

faq.question: How do you put together a proposal if I manage many communities at once?
faq.answer: We prepare a proposal per building, detailing which services each one already has contracted and which could be outsourced to Imora, so you can bring it to each residents' meeting separately if you need to.

madrid.name: Madrid
madrid.heroSubtitle: 24-hour concierge cover, security and maintenance for communities, offices and shopping centres across Madrid city's 21 districts.
madrid.context: Madrid city brings together 21 very different districts: from the dense residential blocks over 60 years old in Centro, Chamberí or Tetuán, to the office towers of the central business area and the newer developments in districts such as Vicálvaro or Villa de Vallecas. That diversity means the same provider has to handle a traditional entrance hall with long-standing residents and a corporate headquarters with electronic access control in the same neighbourhood.

faq.question: Do you work across every district of Madrid city, including those further from the centre?
faq.answer: Yes, we cover all 21 districts; the team assigned to each community or building is organised according to its exact location, from Centro to districts such as Vicálvaro or Villaverde.

faq.question: Can you cover an office building in the central business district as well as a residential community?
faq.answer: Yes, the same services (concierge, cleaning, maintenance, security) apply equally to company premises, residential communities and shopping centres, in any district.

serviceNotes.security: The business districts of the central area tend to combine concierge cover with video surveillance and electronic access control, especially overnight and at weekends, less common in purely residential neighbourhoods.
serviceNotes.pools: Communal pools are more common in peripheral districts with more space per community, such as Hortaleza or Fuencarral-El Pardo, than in the dense blocks of Centro, but both require a qualified lifeguard during the season.

serviceNotes.gardening: Interior courtyards and communal gardens are common in districts with larger blocks, such as Chamartín or Salamanca, while in historic Centro a building's own green space is the exception rather than the rule.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Coordinating plumbing, electrics and locksmithing with a single provider means a community in Centro over 60 years old doesn't need to call a different technician for every fault.

mostoles.context: Móstoles is the most populous town in the region after Madrid city, with a very large stock of residential communities and the south metropolitan area's second public university, Rey Juan Carlos, among its amenities. That volume of population concentrated in a relatively compact area means concierge and cleaning of communal areas are requested with a steadiness few towns in the southern metropolitan area match.

faq.question: How much does concierge service cost in Móstoles?
faq.answer: It depends on coverage hours and the size of the building. We prepare a fixed quote after visiting the property, with no hidden fees.

faq.question: Can I request a one-off clean, not a recurring service, for my community?
faq.answer: Yes, for example after building works or before a community event, as an add-on to the regular plan.

serviceNotes.concierge: Being the most populous town in the region after Madrid city, in Móstoles concierge and cleaning of communal areas are the services with the steadiest demand across the whole stock of residential communities.
serviceNotes.security: Access control is gaining ground in Móstoles' larger blocks, as a complement to concierge services in buildings where a single control point doesn't cover every access.
serviceNotes.pools: With a stock of communities as large as Móstoles', the number of communal pools requiring a qualified lifeguard and chemical maintenance in season is proportionally high compared to smaller towns.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning of communal areas is, along with concierge, the service with the steadiest demand in Móstoles, given the volume of population concentrated in the region's second most populous town.
serviceNotes.gardening: Garden maintenance in Móstoles varies with the type of community, being more relevant in residential complexes with more shared green areas.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance in Móstoles goes alongside the high demand for concierge and cleaning typical of the Community of Madrid's second most populous town.

torrejon-de-ardoz.name: Torrejón de Ardoz
torrejon-de-ardoz.heroSubtitle: Security and access control for communities and industrial estates near the air base and logistics hub of Torrejón de Ardoz, 21 km from Madrid.
torrejon-de-ardoz.context: Torrejón de Ardoz combines block residential communities with a significant industrial and logistics presence, plus a historic air base that has shaped the town's life for decades. That combination of residential housing and logistics and industrial activity gives security and access control a greater weight here than in a purely residential town of similar size.

faq.question: Do you also cover warehouses or mixed-use buildings in Torrejón's logistics area?
faq.answer: The service is mainly designed for residential communities, buildings and businesses; get in touch about your specific case if your property has a different use.

faq.question: How often is a community cleaned in Torrejón?
faq.answer: Whatever the community decides: from a weekly clean to a daily team, depending on the size and use of the property.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Torrejón de Ardoz's block residential communities, concierge services usually coordinate with technical maintenance given the weight of the area's industrial and logistics presence.
serviceNotes.security: Security and access control see especially strong demand in Torrejón de Ardoz, both in residential communities and in facilities linked to the town's industrial and logistics area, historically shaped by its air base.
serviceNotes.pools: Communities with a pool in Torrejón de Ardoz need chemical maintenance and a qualified lifeguard throughout the bathing season, regardless of the town's industrial profile.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning of communal areas in Torrejón de Ardoz is requested continuously in a town that combines block housing with significant industrial and logistics activity.
serviceNotes.gardening: Maintenance of green areas in Torrejón de Ardoz is mostly limited to residential communities, with less weight in the town's industrial and logistics area.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance of communal areas in Torrejón de Ardoz goes alongside a significant industrial and logistics environment, historically reinforced by the town's air base.

coslada.name: Coslada
coslada.heroSubtitle: Security and access control for the industrial estates and communities of Coslada, a rail logistics hub 14 km from Madrid.
coslada.context: Coslada is home to one of the most important rail freight and logistics hubs in southern Europe, with extensive industrial estates sitting alongside a residential stock of medium-sized blocks well connected to Madrid city. That concentration of logistics activity next to residential areas gives security and access control a different weight here than in a purely residential town in the eastern metropolitan area.

faq.question: Do you serve businesses in Coslada's industrial estates as well as residential communities?
faq.answer: Yes, security, concierge and maintenance are contracted the same way for industrial-estate warehouses and offices as for residential communities.

faq.question: Can I contract morning-only concierge cover in Coslada?
faq.answer: Yes, shifts are adjusted to what each community needs: half-day, split shift or full coverage.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Coslada's medium-sized blocks, well-adjusted concierge hours make more of a difference than in a small building, where physical presence matters less day to day.
serviceNotes.security: With one of southern Europe's largest rail logistics hubs within its boundaries, security and access control see a different level of demand in Coslada than in a purely residential town in the eastern metropolitan area.
serviceNotes.pools: Coslada's good connections to Madrid city make it easy for the same team handling a block's concierge service to also take on seasonal pool maintenance, without relying on a separate provider.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning of communal areas in Coslada is requested continuously in the town's medium-sized blocks, well connected to Madrid city.
serviceNotes.gardening: Maintenance of green areas in Coslada is more common in the larger communities, with shared green spaces of their own, away from the town's industrial estates.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance in Coslada is coordinated with concierge services in the town's medium-sized blocks, where both services are usually contracted together.

rivas-vaciamadrid.name: Rivas-Vaciamadrid
rivas-vaciamadrid.heroSubtitle: Pool maintenance and gardening for the recently built developments of Rivas-Vaciamadrid, 18 km south-east of Madrid.
rivas-vaciamadrid.context: Of the 20 towns in this coverage area, Rivas-Vaciamadrid has the most recent urban growth: virtually its entire residential stock has been built since the 1990s, with planned developments that include landscaped areas and a communal pool from day one. Without an old town carrying buildings from another era, its maintenance profile is more uniform than in most towns in the eastern metropolitan area.

faq.question: Do you work with recently built communities in Rivas?
faq.answer: Yes, almost the entire residential stock of the municipality is recently built, so that's the type of community we handle most in Rivas.

faq.question: Is a lifeguard mandatory if the community pool is small?
faq.answer: It depends on regional regulations and the pool's capacity; we advise you based on your community's specific case.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Rivas-Vaciamadrid's planned developments, concierge services are usually coordinated from the community's first year, alongside the rest of the services for the already built installations.
serviceNotes.security: Electronic access control is standard from the outset in Rivas-Vaciamadrid's communities, integrated with the rest of the building's installations since most were built after the 1990s.
serviceNotes.pools: Being a town whose growth is almost entirely post-1990s, Rivas-Vaciamadrid's communities usually arrive with pool installations already built from year one, so maintenance is needed from the moment the community is set up.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning of communal areas in Rivas-Vaciamadrid is requested from the community's formation, given that virtually the entire municipality's residential stock is recently built.
serviceNotes.gardening: Maintenance of green areas is one of the most requested services in Rivas-Vaciamadrid: with barely any old town, almost every community includes a garden from the development's own construction.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance in Rivas-Vaciamadrid is needed from the community's formation, since the installations of its developments, almost all post-1990s, are new alongside the rest of the services.

colmenar-viejo.name: Colmenar Viejo
colmenar-viejo.heroSubtitle: Gardening and maintenance for the historic centre and outlying developments of Colmenar Viejo, next to open grazing land, 29 km north of Madrid.
colmenar-viejo.context: Colmenar Viejo keeps a historic centre with a cattle-farming tradition surrounded by open grazing land and hillside, with streets of low-rise stairwell buildings, alongside more recently built developments on its outskirts with more single-family housing and landscaped areas. It's the town furthest from Madrid city in the northern metropolitan area, and that mix of traditional centre and greener outskirts shapes a different pattern of service demand than other towns in the same area.

faq.question: Do you also cover the developments on the outskirts of Colmenar Viejo, further from the centre?
faq.answer: Yes, the service adapts to both town-centre communities and developments further out, with more landscaped areas of their own.

faq.question: What happens if my community's concierge falls ill?
faq.answer: We cover the absence with another professional of the same profile, at no extra cost and without interrupting the service.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Colmenar Viejo, the same day can involve a low-rise stairwell building in the historic centre and a community in the outlying developments, each with its own concierge needs.
serviceNotes.security: Access control varies a great deal between Colmenar Viejo's historic centre, with its cattle-farming tradition, and the more recently built developments on its outskirts.
serviceNotes.pools: A communal pool is common in Colmenar Viejo's outlying developments, unlike the historic centre, where stairwell buildings without that feature predominate.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning in Colmenar Viejo adapts to two very different building profiles within the same town: the low-rise historic centre and the newer outlying developments.
serviceNotes.gardening: With open grazing land and hillside surrounding the town, garden maintenance carries more weight in Colmenar Viejo's outlying developments than in the historic centre with its cattle-farming tradition.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance in Colmenar Viejo covers both low-rise stairwell buildings in the historic centre and communities in the outlying developments, each with different needs.

torrelodones.name: Torrelodones
torrelodones.heroSubtitle: Security and gardening for the affluent developments of Torrelodones, at the foot of the mountains, 27 km north-west of Madrid.
torrelodones.context: Torrelodones is one of the highest-income municipalities in the Community of Madrid, with a layout dominated by single-family housing developments spread between the town centre and the slopes towards the Guadarrama mountains. Security, access control and maintenance of gardens and private communal pools are the most relevant services for this profile of scattered developments next to the hillside.

faq.question: Do you install video surveillance in single-family housing developments near the mountains?
faq.answer: Yes, we design the system around the development's actual access points, not a standard pattern, adapting it to a more scattered layout than an urban block municipality.

faq.question: Can I expand the security system later on?
faq.answer: Yes, the project is designed so cameras or access-control points can be added later without replacing the whole system.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Torrelodones' single-family housing developments, spread between the town centre and the slopes towards the mountains, concierge services usually combine with access control for the whole residential complex.
serviceNotes.security: Security and access control are among the most relevant services in Torrelodones, given the predominance of scattered single-family housing developments typical of one of the region's highest-income municipalities.
serviceNotes.pools: Maintenance of private communal pools is one of the most relevant services in Torrelodones, typical of the high-income development profile spread between the town centre and the mountainside.
serviceNotes.cleaning: In Torrelodones' developments, cleaning focuses more on shared access points and communal areas than individual block entrance halls, uncommon in this municipality.
serviceNotes.gardening: Garden maintenance is, along with pool care and security, one of the most relevant services in Torrelodones' single-family housing developments, at the foot of the Guadarrama mountains.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Technical maintenance in Torrelodones covers the communal installations of the single-family housing developments spread between the town centre and the slopes towards the mountains.

collado-villalba.name: Collado Villalba
collado-villalba.heroSubtitle: Technical maintenance for communities in Collado Villalba, the furthest town in our coverage, a transport hub for the Guadarrama mountains.
collado-villalba.context: Collado Villalba, 36 km from Madrid city, is the furthest town in our coverage area and works as a gateway and transport hub towards the Guadarrama mountains, with its own long-distance and commuter rail station. Its mixed housing stock of block communities and developments, combined with the mountain climate — more rain and colder winters than Madrid city — means technical maintenance with an in-house team, not reliant on third parties who take time to travel out, is especially valued in the area.

faq.question: Do you cover communities as far out as Collado Villalba?
faq.answer: Yes, being the furthest town in our coverage, our own technical team travels out with the same response standard as in every other area, without relying on a different local provider.

faq.question: Does the mountain climate affect maintenance of installations?
faq.answer: Yes, colder winters and higher rainfall than Madrid city call for different attention to installations like gutters, roofs and heating systems.

serviceNotes.concierge: In Collado Villalba's mixed housing stock, between block communities and developments, concierge services adapt to each residential complex's profile, with hours adjusted to the town's lower density.
serviceNotes.security: Access control in Collado Villalba varies between the town's block communities and its developments, each with different security needs within this transport hub towards the mountains.
serviceNotes.pools: Communities with a pool in Collado Villalba follow the usual maintenance calendar, though the effective bathing season tends to be somewhat shorter than in Madrid city due to the mountain climate.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning in Collado Villalba is split between block communities and developments, with technical maintenance from an in-house team especially valued as the furthest town in our coverage.
serviceNotes.gardening: Maintenance of green areas in Collado Villalba is more relevant in the town's developments than in traditional block communities, with a schedule adjusted to the colder mountain climate.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Being the town furthest from Madrid city in our whole coverage area, technical maintenance with an in-house team, not reliant on third parties who take time to travel out, is especially valued in Collado Villalba.

arganda-del-rey.name: Arganda del Rey
arganda-del-rey.heroSubtitle: Cleaning and electrical maintenance for the old town and expansion areas of Arganda del Rey, in the Jarama river valley, 27 km south-east of Madrid.
arganda-del-rey.context: Arganda del Rey, located in the Jarama river valley, combines a traditional town centre with a wine-growing heritage and residential expansion areas built over recent decades towards the south of the municipality. In the old town's buildings, where electrical and plumbing installations are older, cleaning and technical maintenance tend to require a different frequency than in the newer developments on the outskirts.

faq.question: Can I switch cleaning companies without the change being noticeable?
faq.answer: Yes, we coordinate the transition with the current property management company so the team starts operating from day one with no gap in service.

faq.question: What does electrical maintenance of communal areas include?
faq.answer: We check the main electrical panel and communal-area lighting, with gradual replacement of old lighting with LEDs on request, common in the older buildings of the old town.

serviceNotes.concierge: In the old town buildings of Arganda del Rey, with older installations, concierge services usually require a different approach than the new developments in the expansion areas towards the south of the municipality.
serviceNotes.security: Electronic access control is gaining ground in the more recent residential expansion areas of Arganda del Rey, compared to the traditional town centre with its wine-growing heritage.
serviceNotes.pools: In Arganda del Rey, communal pools are concentrated in the developments of the expansion areas, while old-town buildings rarely have this feature.
serviceNotes.cleaning: Cleaning in the old town buildings of Arganda del Rey, with older installations, tends to require a different frequency than the new developments on the outskirts towards the south of the municipality.
serviceNotes.gardening: Garden maintenance carries more weight in the more recent residential expansion areas of Arganda del Rey than in the municipality's traditional town centre, in the Jarama valley.
serviceNotes.maintenance: Electrical maintenance in the old town buildings of Arganda del Rey, with older installations, tends to require different attention than the new developments on the outskirts.

overview.question: What services does Imora offer?
overview.answer: Concierge and access control, security and CCTV, pool maintenance, cleaning and gardening, and building maintenance. All with our own team, never subcontracted.

conserjeria.question: What does the concierge service include?
conserjeria.answer: Reception, access control, mail distribution and resident assistance, with flexible hours from 6 to 24 hours depending on each building's needs.

seguridad.question: How does the security and CCTV service work?
seguridad.answer: We handle the project, installation and maintenance of video surveillance and access control systems, protecting your building or shopping centre end to end.

maintenance.question: Do you handle building maintenance?
maintenance.answer: Yes. Our own technical team covers plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works in common areas, with a fast response to faults.

schedule.question: What concierge hours can I contract?
schedule.answer: Whatever your building needs: from 6 to 24 hours of service. We adapt the schedule to each community's reality, not the other way round.

availability.question: Do you offer support outside office hours?
availability.answer: Yes. In addition to office hours, we provide 24-hour emergency support, 365 days a year, for any incident that can't wait.

quote.question: How do I request a quote?
quote.answer: Fill in the contact form or call us directly. We carry out an on-site visit and assessment of your community or building, and prepare a fixed quote with a reply within 48 hours, with no obligation.

changeService.question: I want to extend or change my contracted service, who do I talk to?
changeService.answer: Our sales team, who will review your new needs with you and prepare an updated proposal. You can write to them directly from the contact page.

substitutions.question: What happens if a concierge or technician is absent or on leave?
substitutions.answer: We cover any absence with a guaranteed substitute at no extra cost, so the service is never interrupted.

quality.question: How do you monitor service quality?
quality.answer: Our inspection department visits every service on site on a regular basis, to check that what was agreed is being delivered and to spot improvements before they become incidents.

subservices.title: Reception and resident support
subservices.description: The concierge knows every resident by name and which suppliers each home has authorised. Anything they can't resolve on the spot gets logged in a daily report and reaches the property administrator that same day, not at month's end.

subservices.title: Access control
subservices.description: Every visit is logged with an entry time, and the concierge checks identity before letting in anyone they don't recognise. Couriers follow a specific protocol so as not to disturb residents at night.

subservices.title: Mail and parcels
subservices.description: Parcels that need a signature are kept in a marked area and residents are notified through whatever channel the community chooses: a note, WhatsApp or an app. Registered mail and official notices are always handled with proof of receipt.

subservices.title: Cover for sick leave and holidays
subservices.description: Before starting their shift, the substitute is briefed on the building's particulars: residents with special needs, regular suppliers, open incidents. The goal is for the change of person to go unnoticed by the community.

faq.question: How much does the concierge service cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the coverage hours (part-time or 24 hours) and the size of the building. We prepare a fixed quote after visiting the property, with no hidden fees.

faq.question: Can I switch concierge providers without issues?
faq.answer: Yes. We handle the transition with the current property administrator, and if the existing concierge wants to stay on, we consider bringing them onto Imora's team.

faq.question: What happens if the concierge gets sick?
faq.answer: We cover the absence with another professional of the same profile, at no extra cost and with no interruption to the service.

faq.question: Can I hire coverage for mornings only?
faq.answer: Yes, shifts are adapted to what each community needs: half-day, split shift or full 6-to-24-hour coverage.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: The concierge knows the residents and their recurring issues, so they resolve directly what an outsider would have to ask about first: who holds the key to which storage unit, when the cleaning team comes by, or which resident reported a leak.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: A single concierge team can cover several buildings in your portfolio with the same criteria for hours, incident reporting and substitutions, so you don't have to negotiate the service building by building.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: Reception and access control adapt to a business's visitor and supplier volume, not a residential building's rhythm: more traffic at peak times, parcel logging, and attending customers or staff.

security.title: CCTV and Access Control
security.summary: Design, installation and maintenance of video surveillance and access control systems to protect your community, building, business or shopping centre.
security.description: We design the security system around the actual access points of each community, building, business or shopping centre, install it, and maintain it so cameras and access controls are still working the day they're actually needed.
security.cta: Request a security assessment for my building or business

subservices.title: Video surveillance (CCTV)
subservices.description: Cameras go where the building's actual blind spots are (entrances, garage, common areas), not in a standard pattern. Footage is kept for a maximum of 30 days, following the Spanish data protection authority's general guidance on video surveillance.

subservices.title: Electronic access control
subservices.description: Each card or code is tied to a specific home and, if the community asks, to a specific time window. For example, to let an external cleaning crew in only during their contracted hours, with no one needing to open the door for them.

subservices.title: Equipment maintenance
subservices.description: We check cameras and recorders every quarter, and replace recording drives before they fail from wear. The goal is to catch the problem before the community realises it has gone weeks without recording anything.

subservices.title: Technical fault support
subservices.description: A technician reviews the report within 24 working hours. If the fault takes a critical element out of service, such as a downed access camera or a door that won't lock, the repair becomes a priority.

faq.question: How long is footage kept?
faq.answer: A maximum of 30 days, following the Spanish data protection authority's general guidance, unless it's needed for an ongoing investigation.

faq.question: Who can view the recordings?
faq.answer: Only staff authorised by the community, usually the president and the property administrator, with restricted, logged access.

faq.question: Can the system be expanded later?
faq.answer: Yes, the project is designed so cameras or access-control points can be added later without replacing the whole system.

faq.question: What happens if a camera stops working?
faq.answer: It's treated as a priority fault, not routine maintenance: a technician reviews the equipment issue within 24 working hours.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: Cameras are placed at the building's real blind spots (access points, garage, common areas) and access control is tied to each home, not a generic system designed for a different type of property.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: Each community in your portfolio can have its own CCTV and access control system, reviewed under the same quarterly maintenance criteria, without you having to coordinate a different provider per building.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: The security project is designed around a commercial premises or office's real access points (public entrances, loading area, storage), with cards or codes that can be limited to specific time slots.

pools.title: Pool maintenance
pools.summary: Full pool service, with qualified lifeguards throughout the summer season, for homeowner communities, buildings and complexes with a swimming area.
pools.description: We handle the chemical maintenance and cleaning of the community pool, and provide qualified lifeguards throughout the swimming season so the community, building or complex can enjoy the pool fully up to code.
pools.cta: Get my pool ready for the season

subservices.title: Water chemical maintenance
subservices.description: We measure pH (target 7.2-7.6) and free chlorine (0.5-2 mg/l) daily, following Spanish health regulations for collective-use pools. Dosing is adjusted to that day's actual pool usage, not a fixed factory routine.

subservices.title: Cleaning the pool and deck
subservices.description: The pool floor and walls are brushed to prevent algae, and the deck area is cleaned daily during peak season, which is when it actually gets dirty. The goal is for it to actually be clean, not just look it.

subservices.title: Qualified lifeguards
subservices.description: Lifeguards hold a current official water-rescue qualification and cover the full swimming hours the community sets, with no unwatched gap at midday or on the last weekend of the season.

subservices.title: Season opening and closing
subservices.description: Before opening we check pumps, filters and the dosing system, and deep-clean after winter. When closing, we cover the pool and protect the equipment from humidity and cold so it reaches next season intact.

faq.question: When does the service run, from and to?
faq.answer: Usually from June to September, but we adjust the dates to the actual opening and closing calendar the community decides on.

faq.question: Do I need a lifeguard if the pool is small?
faq.answer: It depends on regional regulations and the pool's capacity; we advise you based on your community's specific case.

faq.question: What happens if the lifeguard is out for a day?
faq.answer: We cover the absence with another qualified lifeguard; the pool is never left unwatched during the contracted hours.

faq.question: Can I hire just the chemical maintenance, without a lifeguard?
faq.answer: Yes, water maintenance and lifeguarding can be contracted separately, depending on what the community already has covered.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: Chemical maintenance and cleaning follow the Madrid region's swimming season calendar, with a qualified lifeguard where the pool requires one, so the community doesn't have to manage regulatory compliance on its own.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: If several communities in your portfolio have a pool, the opening, maintenance and season-close calendar is coordinated with a single team, instead of depending on a different lifeguard or company at each building.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: A semi-public pool (hotel, development with a commercial area) has different regulations and swimming volume than a residential community's, and the maintenance plan is adjusted to that real use.

cleaning.title: Cleaning for communities and buildings
cleaning.summary: Complete cleaning of common areas, windows and garages so your community, building, business or shopping centre looks its best all year round.
cleaning.description: A fixed team takes care of cleaning the entrance, stairs, common areas and garage, at whatever frequency each community, building, business or shopping centre needs.

subservices.title: Cleaning common areas
subservices.description: The team follows a task plan by area (entrance, stairs, lift) so no corner gets skipped, at whatever frequency the community, building or business decides: from daily to twice a week.

subservices.title: Window cleaning
subservices.description: Entrance and common-area windows are part of the regular plan. Accessible façade cleaning with a pole is scheduled as an add-on depending on the building's height and access, not bundled by default in every case.

subservices.title: Garage cleaning
subservices.description: Sweeping and mopping the ramp, parking spaces and aisles, with specific treatment for oil and grease stains. Scheduled at whatever frequency the community's, building's or business's car park needs.

subservices.title: Supply of materials
subservices.description: Cleaning products meet current regulations, and Imora offers eco-friendly alternatives at no extra cost if the community prefers them. The community or business never has to buy or store products.

faq.question: How often is the building cleaned?
faq.answer: Whatever the community, building or business decides: from a weekly clean to a daily team, depending on the size and use of the property.

faq.question: Does it include cleaning inside private homes or offices?
faq.answer: No, the service covers common areas only: entrance, stairs, garage and shared outdoor areas.

faq.question: Can I request a one-off clean, not a recurring one?
faq.answer: Yes, for example after building work or before a community or business event, as an add-on to the regular plan.

faq.question: Is garage cleaning included?
faq.answer: It can be included in the general plan or hired as an add-on, depending on the condition and use of the garage or car park.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: Cleaning frequency for the entrance, stairs and garage adapts to the community's actual size, from a weekly clean to a daily team, so the community doesn't over-contract for lack of a middle-ground plan.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: A single cleaning team can serve several communities in your portfolio with consistent quality standards, so you don't have to compare different providers every time a building renews its contract.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: Cleaning for a business or shopping centre is scheduled outside opening hours when requested, and covers areas a residential community doesn't have: shop windows, loading areas or high-traffic common spaces.

gardening.title: Gardening and green areas
gardening.summary: Design, upkeep and pruning of gardens and green areas for communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres.
gardening.description: A gardening team experienced in communities and commercial spaces handles pruning, irrigation and the upkeep of lawns, hedges and green areas, with periodic visits or an annual plan depending on what each property or business needs.

subservices.title: Pruning and tree care
subservices.description: Pruning is planned around each plant's species and flowering season, not a fixed date for the whole garden. Pruning a tree or rose bush at the wrong time can cost you a whole year's blooms or growth.

subservices.title: Automatic irrigation and water control
subservices.description: We check and program automatic irrigation systems to match water use to the season, avoiding both plant water stress and unnecessary spending across common areas, outdoor car parks or business and shopping-centre entrances.

subservices.title: Lawns, hedges and ornamental areas
subservices.description: Mowing, hedge trimming and care of ornamental areas at whatever frequency the season sets, so the green areas of the community, building or shopping centre stay well kept all year round.

subservices.title: Green waste removal
subservices.description: Pruning, mowing and leaf waste is removed after every visit, so the garden area and vehicle or pedestrian access are never left cluttered with green waste.

faq.question: Can gardening be hired together with cleaning?
faq.answer: Yes, it can be hired together with the cleaning service or on its own, depending on what the community, building or business already has in place.

faq.question: How often is the upkeep carried out?
faq.answer: Whatever each community or business decides: from fortnightly visits to a weekly plan during peak season, when growth is highest.

faq.question: Do you service gardens for small communities as well as shopping centres or business parks?
faq.answer: Yes, we adapt the team and frequency to the real size of the green area, from a lobby garden to the outdoor areas of a shopping centre or business park.

faq.question: Does it include replacing plants that don't survive?
faq.answer: Replacing dead or damaged plants is quoted as an add-on service, since it depends on the species and the cause of the damage.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: Garden and green area maintenance adapts to what the community actually has, from a small hedge at the entrance to an extensive green area in a development, with pruning and watering scheduled by season.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: If you manage communities with very different garden profiles (a development with extensive green areas, a block with a small hedge), the service is sized per building without you having to find a gardener for each one.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: A shopping centre or business premises' green areas tend to be more publicly visible than a residential community's, so maintenance prioritises them looking good year-round, not just being tended to.

maintenance.title: Maintenance for communities and buildings
maintenance.summary: Plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works for communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres, with an in-house technical team and fast response times.
maintenance.description: We resolve day-to-day maintenance issues across communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres with our own technical team (not subcontracted), which lets us respond quickly to plumbing, electrical, locksmith or small building work issues.
maintenance.cta: Request technical maintenance for my community or business

subservices.title: Plumbing
subservices.description: Leaks and faults in common areas are handled with the tools the technician already carries, without waiting to source a part. More complex repairs get a quote before any work starts, with no surprises on the bill.

subservices.title: Electrics
subservices.description: We check the main distribution board and common-area lighting, and progressively swap old fittings for LED on request. The community sees the difference directly on its electricity bill.

subservices.title: Locksmithing
subservices.description: A locksmith problem on a common-area entrance is treated as urgent because it's a security issue, not routine maintenance that can wait until Monday.

subservices.title: Small works
subservices.description: One-off masonry, painting or carpentry repairs in common areas that many property administrators leave pending for months for lack of someone to call.

faq.question: How do I report a fault?
faq.answer: By phone, email, or through the building's concierge if you also have that service; the technician reviews the report within the agreed time.

faq.question: Are parts and materials included?
faq.answer: Labour is covered by the contracted plan; materials and replacement parts are quoted separately before any work starts.

faq.question: Do you handle emergencies outside office hours?
faq.answer: Yes, through the 24-hour emergency phone line for issues that can't wait until the next day.

faq.question: Can I hire just one type of maintenance, like electrics?
faq.answer: Yes, each area (plumbing, electrics, locksmithing, small works) can be contracted independently.

communities.title: Homeowner communities
communities.description: A single in-house technical team covers the community's plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works, so a fault doesn't mean finding a different professional for each type of issue.

propertyManagers.title: Property management firms
propertyManagers.description: Coordinating technical maintenance for several buildings with a single provider means each community in your portfolio doesn't need its own trusted plumber, electrician and locksmith, each with different criteria and response times.

businesses.title: Businesses and shopping centres
businesses.description: Technical maintenance for a business or shopping centre is scheduled to minimise impact on activity (outside opening hours when possible), and covers installations a residential community doesn't have, like commercial climate control.
